title: All the Digits
statement: What is the sum of all the digits of all the integers from $1$ to $999{,}999$?
insight: Pad every number to six digits with leading zeros: then each position runs through 0–9 equally often.
redHerring: Summing digit totals block by block for 1–9, 10–99, 100–999, ...
hints: Including 0 and padding to 6 digits doesn't change the digit sum.
Among 000000–999999, how often does each digit appear in a given position?
solution: Write $0,\dots,999{,}999$ as six-digit strings. Each position shows each digit $10^5$ times. Total: $6 \cdot 10^5 \cdot 45 = 27{,}000{,}000$.
